title: Karte Hain Shahadat ka Masoom Safar Dono_
body:
Karte hain shahadat ka masoom safar dono.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahle sitam hai harja jaate hai jidhar dono.
1.Wo momina thi laayi jo thi yateem parwar.
Mehmaan pohnchay jaakar qatil ke hii ghar dono.....
2.Thay dono qaid aise deewar beech may thi.
Rooti thi udhar maadar roote thay idhar dono.....
3.Muslim ke laadlon ne paayi hai yunn shahadat.
Zaalim ne sar hai kaatey zinda hai magar dono.....
4.Dariya ka kanara hai zaalim ki aziyat hai.
Yeh ajre risalat hai hai khoon may tar dono.
5.Maa baap ki duayein thi saat saat inke.
Hairaan thay koofey may yun shams o Qamar dono.....
6.Bhai ka gala kaata bhai ko yunn dikha kar.
Kitne ghareeb thay ye muslim ke pisar dono.....
<<MINI>>
Karte hain shahadat ka masoom safar dono.
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz:-dawar Ali dawar
